text:
maria (Marketing): quick preflight — Tuesday webinar (Americas-friendly). Need final confirmation on Zoom recording + interpretation + post-event lead flow. Main asks: cloud backup, separate audio tracks, Spanish interpretation channel, caption transcript export, clips for socials.

devon (Ops): got it — Zoom settings we should enable: `Record to the cloud`, `Separate audio file for each participant`, and enable `Enable language interpretation`. Also enable `Allow host to view cloud recording` for the ops account. I'll add a local OBS fallback recording. :white_check_mark:

samira (Marketing Ops): registration page checklist — please confirm these fields: company, job role (dropdown), use-case (textarea, 200 chars), consent checkbox + checkbox for future benchmark emails. Add hidden UTM params: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`. For the confirmation page we'll include: replay link (email), TL;DR highlights, CTA to sign up for trial.

kai (Demand Gen): routing: map registrations to HubSpot list `webinar_2026_q1` and add contact property `interested_in=benchmarks`. For MQL scoring, bump +10 for attendees. Post-event: send replay at T+1h to registrants, T+24h to attendees with clip + benchmark one-pager.

maria (Marketing): clips — ops, can you export 3 short clips (30s, 60s, 90s) via the recording? Prefer `speaker-only` tracks for edit. Caption file SRT needed for socials.

devon (Ops): yes. Workflow: 1) cloud recording -> GDrive folder `webinars/2026-03-XX_eventname` 2) run Headliner script to auto-generate 30/60/90s clips with burn-in captions 3) hand off to content for final trim. I'll patch the recording retention policy to 90 days. Example command for Headliner (ops script):
```
./make_clips.sh --input recording.mkv --clips 30,60,90 --captions recording.srt --output /mnt/overnight/clips
```

samira (Marketing Ops): email copy for T+1h replay: short subject `Thanks — replay + TL;DR from <event name>` body: 1-sentence thank-you, 3 bullets TL;DR, link to full replay, 1 clip embedded, CTA `Try Redwood — 14-day free trial`. Also include `benchmark one-pager` PDF attachment for leads who selected "benchmark" on the form.

kai (Demand Gen): tagging ftw: use `lead_source=webinar`, `campaign=2026-q1-virtual-demo`, `creative=benchmark_narrative`. Also add lead owner assignment rule: if company size >100 => AE enterprise queue; else => SDR inbound queue.

maria (Marketing): small ask — for the Spanish interpretation, can we also include a mirrored replay file with audio channel swapped to Spanish-only? Ops, is that extra storage heavy?

devon (Ops): doable. Zoom stores interpretation as extra audio channels; export will produce separate tracks. We'll create a `replay_spanish.mp4` and flag it in the confirmation email as `Recurso en Español`. Storage delta small for one event; we'll delete after 90d unless retention extension requested.

eventbot: Recording scheduled: Tuesday 2026-03-10 15:00 UTC. Cloud recording enabled. Folder reserved: `gdrive.redwood/webinars/2026-03-10-virtual-benchmarks`.

samira (Marketing Ops): action items summary (I'll own the doc): 1) Ops: confirm OBS local fallback + upload script (devon) 2) Ops: export clips + captions (devon) 3) Demand gen: HubSpot mapping + owner rules (kai) 4) Content: edit + social creative + one-pager (maria) 5) Ops: Spanish mirror replay (devon) 6) Marketing Ops: draft T+1h and T+24h emails + confirmation page changes (samira). I'll make a Notion checklist and ping assignees by EOD.

maria (Marketing): thanks — can we add a short benchmark narrative doc (1-pager) to push with the replay: top 3 metrics we show, quick methodology blurb, CTA to run a cost/latency eval with Redwood. Will share draft after this thread.

kai (Demand Gen): note — include UTM `utm_content=benchmark_onepager` on the one-pager link so we can see CTR in GA.

devon (Ops): final ops note: if anyone needs to test interpretation, I can spin a staging Zoom meeting today at 17:00 UTC. Ping me and I'll invite you.

maria (Marketing): perfect. I'll loop in content and the AE leads. Samira — once you post the Notion checklist drop the link here and I'll close the loop. :rocket:
